_instructions.purpose: Writer guidance only, not narration or image content. Read this block before filling the JSON. You may omit _instructions in the finished episode; the importer ignores it.
_instructions.visualStyle: Use brand EPICASTRA_HERITAGE, look CINEMATIC_DEVOTIONAL_3D, borderStrategy NONE for the full-bleed reference-demo look. The pipeline supplies rendering style and reference images; do not add image-model names or reference file paths to JSON.
_instructions.hookVisualPrompt: Required in new scripts. Write an independent English opening still, about 60–100 words: one dominant named subject, visible emotion, one intriguing story-relevant object or clue, exact pose and placement, foreground/background separation, and motivated lighting. State medium-close framing and angle here because there is no hookCamera field. Create curiosity without revealing the payoff; do not repeat scene 1, write narration on the image, or show a title card.
_instructions.visualPrompt: For EVERY scene write about 70–120 English words describing one frozen story moment. Include (1) exact visible character names and age/state, (2) a single action with explicit hands/props and gaze, (3) left/right/upper/lower subject placement and relative scale, (4) story-appropriate clothing and material detail, (5) foreground, midground and background, (6) light direction/source and emotion. Be concrete, not just cinematic, beautiful, highly detailed, or a deity among clouds. Do not describe several successive actions in one still.
_instructions.camera: Required per scene: shot size + angle + composition/focus, for example medium two-shot at eye level, Hanuman left and Jambavan right, both faces sharp with ocean receding behind. A slow pan or push-in alone is insufficient for still generation. Put temporal camera movement in videoPrompt. Hook framing goes in hookVisualPrompt and should agree with the pipeline low-angle medium-close hook framing.
_instructions.characters: featuredLords defines reusable face, complexion, hair, clothing, anatomy and attributes. appearingLords and hookAppearingLords list ONLY visible registered characters using exact nameEn values; use [] for an empty landscape. Use states plus characterStates/hookCharacterStates for CHILD, ADULT, PENANCE or other variants. A state must be a complete identity, not only a costume note. Never use an adult identity for a child. Preserve explicitly specified divine arm/head counts; do not add arbitrary limbs.
_instructions.environment: Use radiant gold, embroidered silk, gems and layered celestial palaces only where appropriate to the story. An earthly forest remains a forest; an ascetic remains simply dressed. Do not copy Vishnu, Ganga, Brahma, waterfalls or palaces into unrelated myths just because they appear in style references. Change shot scale and composition between beats while preserving identities.
_instructions.videoPrompt: Describe motion starting from the exact still: a small subject gesture, expression change, cloth/water/environment movement and one camera movement. Preserve faces, age, clothes and assigned props. Do not repeat the image description or ask for a new scene. Include videoNegativePrompt on every scene; avoid accidental extra anatomy, flicker, face drift, fused fingers and changing props.
_instructions.exclusions: No captions, title lettering, logos, borders, watermarks, play buttons or screenshot UI in imagery. Do not put this instruction block into spokenHook, narrationHi, visualPrompt or videoPrompt. Do not use Markdown comments: return valid JSON.
_instructions.finalCheck: Check hook is distinct from scene 1; every visible principal has a matching registry entry; child scenes select CHILD; hands/props and camera agree; each scene has a different narrative beat; narration/timing rules still hold. Same style does not mean identical compositions or guaranteed image quality.

hookVisualPrompt: Lord Hanuman as an adult sits beside a weathered rock on the ocean shore, his face filling the upper centre of a medium-close composition viewed slightly from below. He looks down at his open right palm with quiet doubt, while his left hand rests on his saffron silk knee cloth. His simian face, single curved tail and engraved gold armlets remain distinct. A blurred immense ocean beyond his shoulder hints at the impossible crossing. Warm dawn light catches his eyes and the gold embroidery; cool sea reflections separate his silhouette.
